_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: First Article Casting Report
summary: The First Article Casting Report provides the Government with inspection and test results and process details for the first article casting to help prevent unapproved changes.
description_purpose: This report provides the Government with the inspection and test results of the first article casting and sufficient details to describe the process required to make the castings to assist in preventing changes without Government approval.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID is applicable to first article casting tests both ferrous and nonferrous.
When so marked, the data product covered by this Data Item Description shall be considered proprietary by the Government and shall not be released to anyone outside the Government.
This DID supersedes, in part, UDI-T-23790.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The first article test report shall be prepared on standard 8-1/2 X 11 inch bond paper in contractor format. First page of the report shall include company letterhead.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: First article casting report shall contain the following: unless otherwise specified.

children.title: Casting drawing number or pattern number.
Location and size of risers, chills and gates
Molding process; i.e., sand, permanent mold, investment, etc.
Mold materials, i.e., type of sand, binder, etc.
Type of melting and refining unit
Actual heat treatment times and temperatures.
Results of the specified first article radiographic inspections.
Results of the specified first article mechanical property tests, including location of test specimens.
Results of any other tests required by the applicable specification and the contract for the first article casting.

preparation_instructions.title: Additional content.
preparation_instructions.content: Sketches, drawings, and photographs shall be included as necessary to fully describe or clarify the text material. The report shall contain the signature of a responsible company officer, identification number, and date.
